messages.subject: Display/Save R console log in shiny
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to find a way for debugging my shiny app on my server (Google Compute). I discoverd that shiny-server.log is not good enough because it does not present all of the console data. So, there are two options I can think about:
1. Save each console session data in to a file on my server.
2. Show in realtime the console data in the ui.

Do you have any ideas how to do it?

Thanks,

Avner

messages.author: 91bee2fcb8329b57
messages.subject: Re: Display/Save R console log in shiny
parts:
I'm not sure if this will fully fit your needs, but since Shiny is closer to a production system than just an ordinary R script, I would think of using a logger such as futile.logger, log4r or logging.
See more details here:
  1. http://stackoverflow.com/questions/1928332/is-there-any-standard-logging-package-for-r
  2. http://www.r-bloggers.com/futile-logger-1-3-3-rc-available/
You just call the logger methods with any string/output you'd like, and it gets saved to a file and/or console. You would probably need to adjust your code and explicitly call the logger methods on each string you want to be logged.
I haven't checked it myself on shiny, but that's usually the way to go in such systems (e.g. log4j, log4net, etc.)

Hope it helps!
